u: rctest(1) is used to test RFCOMM communications on the BlueZ stack

-r
listen and receive
-w
listen and send
-d
listen and dump incoming data
-s
connect and send
-u
connect and receive
-n
connect and be silent
-c
connect, disconnect, connect, ...
-m
multiple connects

-b bytes
send/receive bytes
-i device
select the specified device
-P channel
select the specified channel
-U uuid
select the specified uuid
-L seconds
enable SO_LINGER options for seconds
-W seconds
enable deferred setup for seconds
-B filename
use data packets from filename
-N num
send num frames
-C num
send num frames before delay (default: 1)
-D milliseconds
delay milliseconds after sending num frames (default: 0)
-A
request authentication
-E
request encryption
-S
secure connection
-M
become central
-T
enable timestamps
